label: refusalAsSuccess: the kernel's refused stopwatch is taken as done, so a one-frame composition gets no key
find: if !KeyRules.toggleAnimated(&track, at: f, lastFrame: other, value: v) { track = [HaloKeyframe(frame: f, value: v)] }
replace: _ = KeyRules.toggleAnimated(&track, at: f, lastFrame: other, value: v)

label: lastFrameKept: the stopwatch at the last frame asks the kernel for the last frame again instead of frame 0
playheadValueStays: a track the kernel empties goes static at the removed key's value, not the key that stays
find: if track.count < 2 { setStatic(staying ?? v, p, of: &layer) }

label: keyStateSwapped: the kernel's keyedHere maps to animated
handlesSwapped: Halo's first handle moves the kernel's second
allIsAProperty: the kernel's .all key maps to a Halo key on x
find: guard case .property(let property) = key.track else { return nil }
replace: let property: HaloProperty = if case .property(let p) = key.track { p } else { .x }
